prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1293; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports vehicle was struck on the driver side while proceeding through on a green signal. Police report requested and pending. Liability not yet determined.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant states they have a knee injury from the impact, sustained when the knee struck the interior door panel. Claimant has not yet sought treatment beyond an initial urgent care visit. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and asked what the next steps are for the injury portion of the claim.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos of claimant vehicle. Driver side door deformation and intrusion noted. Airbag deployment confirmed on driver side. Repair estimate requested from preferred body shop. Recorded claimant's statement that the knee was swollen and painful to bend the day after the collision.

Entry 4: Obtained urgent care records through claimant authorization. Diagnosis noted as a knee contusion with possible ligament strain, with follow-up referral to an orthopedic provider. Sent claimant a written explanation of the medical payments coverage and how bills can be submitted. Advised claimant that they may wish to consult an attorney, though they are not required to.

Entry 5: Orthopedic follow-up scheduled per claimant report. Awaiting MRI results and treatment plan before evaluating the injury claim. Liability review still open pending police report and statement from the other driver. Diary set for follow-up in two weeks.
